open_points.subject: functions.add_captured_trial_case input-reference contract
open_points.text: “The functions capability keeps the broad PortRef input contract” and “Any FileFactsRef, including an empty file list, is refused” contradict the public operation’s Inputs: “the record's inputs as references — StoredValues, and spooled files as their SpooledFiles”. No PortRef or FileFactsRef variant is defined, including how an empty FileFactsRef list is distinguishable from an empty SpooledFilesRef list.
open_points.question: Does add_captured_trial_case accept a tagged PortRef union containing StoredValuesRef, SpooledFilesRef and FileFactsRef, and if so what identifies each variant—especially for an empty file list—or are FileFactsRef inputs impossible under this public API?
options: Define the input as an explicitly discriminated PortRef union with FileFactsRef as a permitted-but-refused variant
Keep only StoredValues and SpooledFiles as inputs and remove the unreachable FileFactsRef behavior
Use an untagged representation and specify an independent rule that distinguishes empty facts-only and readable file lists
open_points.default_guess: Use an explicitly tagged PortRef union so FileFactsRef remains detectable and refusible even when its file list is empty.
